Canonical normalized laws/kernel, onto pullback e, SAME U/T, full and centered roots, exact centering, gap, unit and bounded inverse are conclusions. Conditional actions are per-observable AE. L² is not assumed finite-dimensional.
γ=2√(αη)/(1+αη); the inverse acts only on H_P^0=ker⟨e1,·⟩ with inherited Hilbert structure; the legal endpoint αη=1 is retained.

H_perp is exactly ker P (conditional expectation given Y), while H_P^0 is the zero ν-mean macroscopic space. Their complete Hilbert structures, B_0 and V_0 are internally constructed; no onto-kerP or coisometry assumption is introduced.

publications.complete_lesson_statement: Let E be a finite-dimensional real Hilbert Borel space with canonical volume, including the explicit rank-zero extension. Let V:E→ℝ be C², 0<α≤β, and assume α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v. Assume η>0 and βη≤1. Define μ(dx) proportional to exp(−V(x))dx, J as the law of (X,X+√η Z) for independent X~μ and Z~N(0,I), ν=J.snd, and Λ as the law of (Y,2X−Y) under J. These are probability laws. Put mY=comap(snd), H_P=L² classes measurable with respect to mY, P=i∘E[·|Y] and the canonical M:u↦u∘snd. Then H_P=ran(P), P is identity on H_P, and there exists an onto linear isometry e:L²(ν;ℝ)≃H_P with i e=M. There is a Markov kernel S whose every-state normalized law is S(y)=volume.tilted(x↦−V((y+x)/2)−‖y−x‖²/(8η)); Λ.IsCondKernel S and both Λ marginals equal ν. The same joint reflection F(x,y)=(x,2x−y) gives the involutive selfadjoint isometry U, with Uf=f∘F J-almost everywhere for every f. There is a bounded selfadjoint T on the full real L²(ν), with ‖Tu‖≤‖u‖, Tu(y)=∫u(x)S(y,dx) ν-almost everywhere for each u, and preserved integral. On H_P put A=PUP restricted via i and orthogonal projection, and B=(I_J−P)UPi:H_P→L²(J). Then A=eTe⁻¹ is selfadjoint and contractive, PB=0. There is a bounded positive operator Γ on the real scalar-valued L² space with Γ²=I−T². For the SAME transported Γ_P=eΓe⁻¹, positivity holds and Γ_P²=I_H_P−A²=B*B. There is q∈L²(ν;ℝ) equal to one ν-almost everywhere, with Tq=q and ⟨q,u⟩=∫u dν for every u. Set q_P=e q and H_P^0=ker⟨q_P,·⟩, with its inherited Hilbert structure. Membership is exactly zero ν-mean after e⁻¹. The SAME Γ_P annihilates q_P. Put γ=2√(αη)/(1+αη)>0. There exists Γ_0:H_P^0→H_P^0 equal under inclusion to the restriction of Γ_P, positive with Γ_0−γ I positive. Γ_0 is a unit in the algebra of bounded real operators. There exists a bounded real Inv on this SAME centered space with Inv Γ_0=Γ_0 Inv=I and ‖Inv‖≤1/γ. All probability, normalization, range, root, centering, spectral-gap, unit and inverse facts are internally derived from the original inputs; none is an additional public premise. αη=1 and rank-zero E remain legal. No inverse on full H_P is asserted. Define the actual closed conditional-mean-zero space H_perp=ker P in L²(J;ℝ), with its inherited complete Hilbert structure; this is not merely the globally zero-mean joint space. There exists B_0:H_P^0→H_perp whose inclusion equals B i_0. There exists V_0:H_P^0→H_perp with V_0=B_0 Inv, B_0=V_0 Γ_0, V_0* V_0=I and ‖V_0 f‖=‖f‖ for every f∈H_P^0. All these objects and identities are conclusions from the same original inputs. There exists the canonical bounded residual map R:L²(J;ℝ)→H_perp with i_perp Rg=g−Pg for every joint g. The SAME ambient adjoint satisfies B* g=i_0 B_0* Rg for every joint g; the printed intrinsic block adjoint is recovered on H_perp. For every actual joint f∈L²(J;ℝ) with ∫f dJ=0, there exists f_P∈H_P^0 whose inclusion is E[f|Y]. Put f_perp=Rf and f_V=V_0* f_perp∈the SAME H_P^0. Then B* i_perp f_perp=i_0 Γ_0 f_V=Γ_P i_0 f_V, ‖f‖²=‖f_P‖²+‖f_perp‖² and ‖f_V‖≤‖f_perp‖. The preceding independently reviewed ambient-adjoint Test derives f=i i_0 f_P+i_perp f_perp, B* f=Γ_P i_0 f_V and ‖f_V‖²≤‖f‖²−‖f_P‖². The global zero-mean condition is a quantified input restriction to this concluded implication, not an extra assumption on the potential or an operator certificate. The SAME root commutes with T and its transport commutes with A. The SAME Inv on H_P^0 is selfadjoint. There exists an internally constructed A_0:H_P^0→H_P^0 whose inclusion equals A after inclusion; it is selfadjoint,commutes with Γ_0,satisfies A_0²+Γ_0²=I,and commutes with the SAME Inv. The genuine original-input Test proves K=A_0 Inv selfadjoint and I+K²=Inv². All old ambient-adjoint/global-centered-observable conclusions persist. These are ingredients for sharp B23 and B21;neither estimate/rotation nor full dynamics,expected costs or composition is asserted. Private literal proposition definitions store the complete original statements and add no premise or provider.

letI := IsStarNormal.instNonUnitalContinuousFunctionalCalculus
    (A := Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ)
  letI : NonUnitalContinuousFunctionalCalculus ℂ
      (Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) IsStarNormal :=
    NonUnitalClosedEmbeddingContinuousFunctionalCalculus.toNonUnitalContinuousFunctionalCalculus
  letI : NonUnitalContinuousFunctionalCalculus ℝ
      (Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ) IsSelfAdjoint :=
    IsSelfAdjoint.instNonUnitalContinuousFunctionalCalculus
      (A := Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ)
  let ι : Lp ℝ 2 μ →L[ℝ] Lp ℂ 2 μ := Complex.ofRealCLM.compLpL 2 μ
  let R : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 μ := Complex.reCLM.compLpL 2 μ
  let Q : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 μ := Complex.imCLM.compLpL 2 μ
  obtain ⟨hNorm,_,Gc,hGc,hGf,hGi,_⟩ :=
    L2RealComplexOperator.exists_positive_complex_lift μ G hG
  obtain ⟨_,_,Dc,hDc,hDf,hDi,_⟩ :=
    L2RealComplexOperator.exists_positive_complex_lift μ D hD

ten_literal_BODY_formula_steps.formula: G^2D=DG^2\Rightarrow G_{\mathbb C}^2D_{\mathbb C}=D_{\mathbb C}G_{\mathbb C}^2.
ten_literal_BODY_formula_steps.literal_Lean_RAW:
have hReal (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) : G (G (D u)) = D (G (G u)) :=
    congrArg (fun A : Lp ℝ 2 μ →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 μ => A u) hCommute.eq
  have hComplex : Commute (Gc*Gc) Dc := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro g
    change Gc (Gc (Dc g)) = Dc (Gc (Gc g))
    calc
      Gc (Gc (Dc g)) = ι (G (G (D (R g)))) + Complex.I • ι (G (G (D (Q g)))) := by
        rw [hDf g, map_add, map_smul, hGi, hGi, map_add, map_smul, hGi, hGi]
      _ = ι (D (G (G (R g)))) + Complex.I • ι (D (G (G (Q g)))) := by
        rw [hReal (R g),hReal (Q g)]
      _ = Dc (Gc (Gc g)) := by
        rw [hGf g,map_add,map_smul,hGi,hGi,map_add,map_smul,hDi,hDi]
ten_literal_BODY_formula_steps.text: Apply the real identity separately to real and imaginary parts and use complex linearity;this proves equality of full complex operators.
ten_literal_BODY_formula_steps.title: Lift square commutation

ten_literal_BODY_formula_steps.formula: \sqrt{G_{\mathbb C}^2}=G_{\mathbb C},\quad[G_{\mathbb C}^2,D_{\mathbb C}]=0\Rightarrow[G_{\mathbb C},D_{\mathbb C}]=0.
ten_literal_BODY_formula_steps.literal_Lean_RAW:
have hGcNonneg : 0 ≤ Gc := (ContinuousLinearMap.nonneg_iff_isPositive Gc).mpr hGc
  have hRoot : CFC.sqrt (Gc*Gc)=Gc := CFC.sqrt_unique rfl hGcNonneg
  have hLift : Commute Gc Dc := by
    have h := hComplex.cfcₙ_nnreal NNReal.sqrt
    change Commute (CFC.sqrt (Gc*Gc)) Dc at h
    rwa [hRoot] at h
ten_literal_BODY_formula_steps.text: The unique positive root of Gc² is Gc. Commutation with the argument passes to its continuous functional calculus.
ten_literal_BODY_formula_steps.title: Commute with the same positive square root

let e : Lp ℝ 2 μ →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Lp ℂ 2 μ :=
    { toLinearMap := ι.toLinearMap, norm_map' := hNorm }
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro u
  apply e.injective
  change ι (G (D u))=ι (D (G u))
  rw [← hGi (D u), ← hDi u, ← hDi (G u), ← hGi u]
  exact congrArg (fun A : Lp ℂ 2 μ →L[ℂ] Lp ℂ 2 μ => A (ι u)) hLift.eq

classical
  unfold actual_same_root_inverse_commutation_statement
  dsimp only
  let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
  let J := (μ.prod (stdGaussian E)).map
    (fun p : E × E => (p.1,p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2))
  let ν := J.snd
  let mY : MeasurableSpace (E × E) := MeasurableSpace.comap Prod.snd (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace E)
  letI : MeasurableSpace (E × E) := Prod.instMeasurableSpace
  letI : Fact (mY ≤ (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (E × E))) := ⟨measurable_snd.comap_le⟩
  let HP := lpMeas ℝ ℝ mY 2 J
  letI : NormedAddCommGroup HP := HP.normedAddCommGroup
  letI : InnerProductSpace ℝ HP := HP.innerProductSpace
  let P : Lp ℝ 2 J →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 J :=
    HP.subtypeL ∘L condExpL2 ℝ ℝ (μ := J) measurable_snd.comap_le
  have hBase := AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.AmbientAdjointCorrector.actual_ambient_adjoint_centered_decomposition
    (E:=E) (V:=V) (α:=α) (β:=β) (η:=η) hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  rcases hBase with
    ⟨hμ,hJ,hν,hRange,hPf,S,hS,hSd,hSc,hSf,hSs,e,he,U,hU,hUi,hUs,
      T,hTs,hAll,hAeq,hAs,hAn,hPB,Γ,hΓ,hΓSq,hΓP,hΓPSq,hGram,
      q,hqa,hTq,hq,hCenter,hΓPq,hγ,ΓP0,hΓP0,hPos0,hOrder0,hUnit,
      Inv,hLeft,hRight,hNormInv,B0,hB0,V0,hVdef,hFactor,hVadj,hVnorm,R,hR,hAmbient,hGlobal⟩
  let A : HP →L[ℝ] HP := HP.orthogonalProjectionOnto ∘L U.toContinuousLinearMap ∘L HP.subtypeL
  let B : HP →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 J :=
    (((1 : Lp ℝ 2 J →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 J)-P)*U.toContinuousLinearMap*P) ∘L HP.subtypeL
  let ΓP : HP →L[ℝ] HP := e.conjStarAlgEquiv Γ
  let qP : HP := e q
  let HP0 := (innerSL ℝ qP).ker
  letI : NormedAddCommGroup HP0 := HP0.normedAddCommGroup

  letI : CompleteSpace HP0 := (innerSL ℝ qP).isClosed_ker.completeSpace_coe
  let Hperp := P.ker

  letI : CompleteSpace Hperp := P.isClosed_ker.completeSpace_coe
  change HP0 →L[ℝ] Hperp at B0 V0
  change HP0 →L[ℝ] HP0 at ΓP0 Inv
  change Lp ℝ 2 J →L[ℝ] Hperp at R
  change (∀ g : Lp ℝ 2 J, (R g : Lp ℝ 2 J)=g-P g) at hR
  change (∀ g : Lp ℝ 2 J,
    B.adjoint g=HP0.subtypeL (B0.adjoint (R g))) at hAmbient
  change (∀ f : Lp ℝ 2 J, (∫ z, f z ∂J)=0 →
    ∃ fP : HP0,
